notes.title: Patch 1 now live!
notes.notes:
In this patch:

[b]FIXED:[/b]

[list]
    [*]Level 14 and 24 going back to Level 1
    [*]Overlaps in random levels
    [*]Music muting when entering options menu
    [*]Overlaps in level editor
    [*]Custom level loading issues
    [*]Text overlap
[/list]


[b]IMPROVEMENTS:[/b]

[list]
    [*]Added restart hotkey: R
    [*]Improved star detection system
[/list]

Expect in patch 2 fixes for the below issues:

[list]
    [*]Long loading times in certain menus
[/list]

notes.title: Multimirror is now available!
notes.notes:
Multimirror is now available for purchase on Steam! The game retails for $4.99 with a 10% launch discount.

To provide comments to developers, please use this [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/533860/discussions/0/217691032446363021/]thread[/url]. Also, check out the [url=steamcommunity.com/app/533860/discussions/0/217691032446356426/]Multimirror Level-Creation Contest![/url]

notes.title: Multimirror releases on November 14!
notes.notes:
[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26371112/ccc2ae0faca9c53cd7b4bf3b99a04b2c83a0d4ba.png[/img]

Multimirror will be available worldwide on November 14, 9 PM Pacific. The game will be available for purchase on Steam and Humble Store.

Thanks!
The Cleverweek Team
